ctx.x: I had a lot of people to influence me that I lived to listen to at that time. I had Coleman Hawkins, I had Don Byas, I had Ben Webster with Duke, I had Joe Thomas with Luntford. Now, out of all of those -- I loved them all, but you know who I was influenced by more than all of them? Joe Thomas.
